# Jon Lieff, M.D.

> A psychiatrist and neuroscientist exploring the intelligence of cells and the mind-body connection through research, writing, and public engagement.

Dr. Jon Lieff, trained at Yale University and Harvard Medical School, investigates cellular communication and consciousness through his book 'The Secret Language of Cells,' blog articles, speaking engagements, and media appearances. The site serves as a hub for his neuroscience research, clinical insights, and public education on cellular intelligence and neuropsychiatry.

## Key Topics

- Cellular intelligence
- Cellular communication
- Neuroscience
- Neuropsychiatry
- Cellular biology
- Mind-body connection
- Consciousness
- Brain injuries
- Immune system
- The Secret Language of Cells
- Podcast interviews
- Yale University
- Harvard Medical School
- Sports medicine
- Mind research
